jcr:title: Sling Resource Resolution
author: cms-admin
body:
Sling Resource Resolution is one of the core concepts in Apache Sling. It maps HTTP requests to JCR resources through a sophisticated resolution process that considers URL patterns, resource types, and selectors.

The resolution process works by traversing the resource tree to find the best match for a given URL. Sling uses resource types (sling:resourceType property) to determine which scripts or components should handle the request.

Key features include script resolution based on resource type and selectors, automatic content negotiation, and the ability to overlay content through the Sling Resource Merger.
summary: How Apache Sling maps URLs to content resources and determines request handling.
tags: Sling Resource Resolution, URL Mapping, Resource Types, Selectors, Content Negotiation
title: Sling Resource Resolution
